newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau airport cargo and passenger figures rise.
newsitem.headline: Macau airport cargo and passenger figures rise.

text.p: Macau International airport handled 3,132 tonnes of cargo last month, an airport spokesman told Reuters.
This compared to 3,736 tonnes in March, which was the second highest monthly total recorded since the airport opened in November 1995.
Passengers passing through Macau airport set a new monthly record in April of 179,049, the spokesman said.
And its two millionth passenger since opening is expected to pass through this week, he added.
Macau handled 11,655 tonnes of cargo between January-April 1997 compared to 2,510 tonnes in the same period last year and a total for 1996 of 25,047 tonnes, the spokesman said.
